# geminex v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

Geminex is an Elixir client for Gemini's API, providing streamlined access to trading, account management, and market data. It simplifies integration with Gemini’s REST API, handling authentication, requests, and responses for both public and private endpoints.

## Modules

- [Geminex.API.Private](https://geminex.hexdocs.pm/Geminex.API.Private.md): Private API endpoints for Gemini.
- [Geminex.API.Public](https://geminex.hexdocs.pm/Geminex.API.Public.md): Public API endpoints for Gemini.

- [Geminex.Utils](https://geminex.hexdocs.pm/Geminex.Utils.md): Utility functions for handling common tasks within the Geminex library.
